[spoiler=[u][b]Information about the OVT2-LV Vaccine from the Nordiheimian department of health![/b][/u]]

After many demands and questions from various citizens, some polite and other less so, for some more information about how the vaccine works if they are to fully accept its mandatory injection into their bodies.
The minister of wisdom have authorized the health department to realese this information to the public to ease their minds and hopefully answer any consearns they might have.

The vaccine is created by taking laboratory grown/cultivated batches of the LV2B virus, the dirctly related but far more benign variant of the Lyondar virus that was discovered a while back, and rendering them "inactivated", this is done by heat treating it so that it looses its ability to replicate and infect a person.

It is then mixed with the following, non-dangerous, components:
-Sucrose: To stabilize it and prevent degration over time.
-Polysorbate: to prevent the different componnents from seperating.
-Thimerosal: to prevent contamination.
-Gentamicin: very small amount, to prevent bacteria contamination in the production prosses.
These are all commonly used components in influenza vaccines, and been tested for safety many times.

Ones a person is injected with the vaccine the 'inactivated' LV2B virus will be [u][b]Compleatly unable to make you sick[/b][/u] but your bodies immune defence will still be able to recognice it as a treath and start its natural defence prosses to make antibodies to kill/destroy the "intruder".
Some people may experience some mild reactions to it, such as soreness, redness or slight swelling were they were given the shot, but all this means is that your immune system is working and doing its jobb.

After the vaccine takes full effect (father roughly 2 weeks) you will be far less likely to be infected by the Lyondar virus, and if you should be so become infected anyway it will be less severe, more short-lived and unlikely to be deadly, but please contact your local hospital anyway joust to be safe.

In the case of pregnant women the vaccine also works for their child for up to 6 months after birth, wich will provide it [b]vital[/b] protection as infants that are younger then 6 months can not be safely given a direct vaccine.

We hope this answer our citizens questions and consearns.

When a majorety of the population is vaccined we expect that we can start lifting the emergency lock-down measures, so cooperation will aid in making this happen as soon as posible.
